title: Validator draft, pending 05's review

title: Salt zones sink on NISAR 094D
detail: Median line-of-sight rate over the zone pixels: +23.5 mm/yr from 79 pixels (needs < -2; phase sign -1). Not a global sign error: see notebooks/03/t3_094d_checks.json; the track is held off the page.

title: Salt zones sink on NISAR 129A
detail: Median line-of-sight rate over the zone pixels: -10.1 mm/yr from 85 pixels (needs < -2; phase sign -1).

title: Held-out station HORE against NISAR
detail: 129A: no coherent pixel within 240 m. The GNSS series ends in 2020: it assumes steady motion since. Source: NGL MIDAS (EU-fixed).

title: Held-out station VLC1 against NISAR
detail: 129A: NISAR +3.9 vs GNSS -0.6 mm/yr (±2.7, 49 px). The GNSS series ends in 2018: it assumes steady motion since. Source: NGL MIDAS (EU-fixed).

title: Held-out station VLC2 against NISAR
detail: 129A: NISAR +3.9 vs GNSS +0.3 mm/yr (±2.7, 49 px). The GNSS series ends in 2025: it assumes steady motion since. Source: Muntean et al. 2026.

title: Tie scatter on NISAR 094D
detail: Robust scatter of NISAR minus euvem on 157186 stable pixels: 47.6 mm/yr per pixel (target < 6); offset correction -15.15 mm/yr; model swap against egms: 0.70 mm/yr (T8 < 1). Per-pixel rates are noise-dominated: read zones and areas, not single dots.

title: Model swap on NISAR 094D
detail: Changing the GNSS model to egms moves the tied rates by 0.70 mm/yr (needs < 1, T8).

title: Tie scatter on NISAR 129A
detail: Robust scatter of NISAR minus euvem on 66648 stable pixels: 26.3 mm/yr per pixel (target < 6); plane correction -7.78 mm/yr; model swap against egms: 0.74 mm/yr (T8 < 1). Per-pixel rates are noise-dominated: read zones and areas, not single dots.

title: Model swap on NISAR 129A
detail: Changing the GNSS model to egms moves the tied rates by 0.74 mm/yr (needs < 1, T8).

title: Zone 1: NISAR 129A against Sentinel-1 029A
detail: Zone minus outer comparison area, 2026-07-07 to 2026-10-04: NISAR -30.8 (scaled ×1.02, vertical motion assumed; O-19 open) against Sentinel-1 -49.6 mm/yr; difference +18.8, tolerance ±58.1 (2σ, dates assumed independent: a lower bound); 6 and 15 dates, 32 and 21 px. The tolerance is wider than 20 mm/yr, so agreeing is not evidence; both satellites show the zone moving away from the satellite relative to its surroundings.
